The files do **not** state what the club paid for water in 2025.

Here is what the files do contain on the subject:

* **2025 Water Bill Reference (No Figure):** In the 8 September 2026 minutes ([Meeting sept 8.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r2/notes/Meeting%20sept%208.md#L15-L16)), the 2026 water bill up to that date was **$312.40**, which Paolo noted was *"a little under last year's [2025's] pace,"* but he *"did not have last year's figure with him."*
* **2026 Total Water Bill:** In the 3 November 2026 minutes ([Nov 3 (final).md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r2/notes/Nov%203%20(final).md#L18)), the total water bill for **2026** came to **$486.75**.
* **2025 Electricity Bill (Different Utility):** The 11 August 2026 minutes ([aug11.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r2/notes/aug11.md#L8-L9)) record a 2025 utility cost, but it is for **electricity** (shed lights), which was **$96.20** for the whole year.
* **Other Water Matters in 2026:**
  * **Second tap:** Members requested a second tap at the far end of the plots; Nell Okonjo and later Dov Marchetti followed up with the city, which had not yet decided as of 3 November ([aug11.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r2/notes/aug11.md#L11-L12), [minutes 25 aug.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r2/notes/minutes%2025%20aug.md#L10-L11), [Meeting sept 8.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r2/notes/Meeting%20sept%208.md#L21), [notes_2026-09-22.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r2/notes/notes_2026-09-22.md#L18-L19), [2026.10.20 minutes.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r2/notes/2026.10.20%20minutes.md#L14-L15), [Nov 3 (final).md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r2/notes/Nov%203%20(final).md#L15-L16)).
  * **Winter water shut-off:** Water shut-off was added to the winter closing checklist ([oct6 meeting notes.md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r2/notes/oct6%20meeting%20notes.md#L13-L15)), with Wren Castellan scheduled to shut off the water on the 14 November work day ([Nov 3 (final).md](file://<tmp>/t5-practice-r2/notes/Nov%203%20(final).md#L13)).
